title: State Machine
hero_prompt: A Dürer-style woodcut engraving, wide banner, dense parallel hatching. A four-chambered clockwork wheel turns through a fixed cycle — charge, rise, fall, recovery — each chamber a distinct engraved mechanism with interlocking gear teeth at the seams, a hand resting on a crank that turns only one way.
icon_prompt: Bold woodcut-silhouette icon: a four-spoked wheel with each quadrant filled a different flat tone, heavy outline only, no gear-tooth detail, high contrast, reads at small size.
